name: AntiLeak-Bench
description: AntiLeak-Bench is an automated benchmarking framework designed to prevent data contamination by constructing samples with explicitly new knowledge absent from LLMs' training sets. It enables strictly contamination-free evaluation and features a fully automated workflow for building and updating benchmarks without human labor.
reputation: A recent contamination-focused benchmark framework that is notable in the research community for addressing data leakage, but it is not yet a widely established standard benchmark.
notes: Focuses on eliminating data contamination in LLM evaluation by using new knowledge samples and automating benchmark updates.
